summary: Printed apparatus is welded onto the front of four released arcika verses by the parser.
detail: Leading editorial matter that belongs to the page apparatus, not the verse, is included in text_original. Every codepoint still comes from the pinned page, so this is not a codepoint-reproduction failure; it is a unit-boundary failure. The release containment check cannot see it because it collapses whitespace before comparing, which is what hides the join.
found_by: independent re-verification of the Samaveda codepoint gate

summary: The canonical release under data/canonical/** is gitignored, so no released corpus is protected by git history.
detail: This is the same class of hazard already recorded for the sealed schema, which was once destroyed by a schema export and recovered only from a dangling git blob. It applies to every Veda, not only the Samaveda.
found_by: independent re-verification of the Samaveda codepoint gate
